body.name: Response-function fiber-product lift handle
body.construction: Encode every finite one-step mechanism by categorical response functions; induct upward by coupling only incompatible action-subtree maxima and disintegrating each subtree on its assigned maximum. After the reached response system is assembled, invoke the dormant-kernel extension lemma on each \(\sim_v\)-equivalence class, assigning its unique reached value when one exists and an arbitrary common stochastic vector otherwise, then audit joint consistency and every single-world product formula on \(G(d)\).
